key_insight: A local two-stage large language model pipeline can accurately identify hepatocellular carcinoma reports and extract structured pathology variables from German free-text reports without sending sensitive data خارج the institution.
clinical_relevance: This could speed up pathology registry curation and quality control by turning unstructured reports into analyzable data while preserving privacy.
method: Stage 1 used a lightweight gatekeeper model to筛选 confirmed HCC cases from 2,864 reports.
Stage 2 used a larger model to extract 15 predefined histopathology variables into JSON.
Performance was compared with expert-curated reference annotations using accuracy, macro F1, and Cohen’s kappa.
evidence_signal: The best setup achieved zero classification errors in cohort identification, and the 31B model reached near-perfect extraction performance with Macro F1 > 0.99.
watch_item: Real-world deployment still needs careful validation across other hospitals, report styles, and model updates to ensure reliability and generalizability.
paper_title: Large Language Models for Structured Information Extraction from German Histopathology Reports - Hepatocellular Carcinoma
